title: V1 Release Packaging and Pilot Readiness

notes: Packages and verifies the already-approved V1 functionality without adding product features.
API build/start, readiness, exact-SHA provenance, migration tooling, container packaging and pilot smoke are implemented and reviewed.
DEC-008 is approved for a split non-production pilot topology.
PR #35 fixes Vercel build-time Neon Auth initialization by deferring auth construction to request time while preserving mandatory runtime secrets.
The previous REL-001 release approval and RB-001 target were bound to 84b778660f9d0152a7a0aa248317b476f15215d4 and must be reconciled before releasing the newly certified runtime candidate.

approvals.rationale: Approved the next V1 packaging and pilot-readiness phase; no product scope expansion.
No new product policy is introduced; pilot hosting is governed separately by approved DEC-008.
Approved bounded packaging, verification, tests and fixes outside production.

Approved exact-SHA certification of PR #35 candidate 5331e5fbe07269e395e4ac86bfbe2d3609672d3a after CI #339, Security baseline #301 and the Vercel Git preview all passed on that exact SHA. Certification only; merge, release, production enablement and deployment remain separate approvals.

The prior release approval was bound to 84b778660f9d0152a7a0aa248317b476f15215d4 and does not transfer to the newly certified runtime candidate 5331e5fbe07269e395e4ac86bfbe2d3609672d3a. A new exact-SHA release approval is required after merge and REL-001/RB-001 reconciliation.
